about_the_game:
Ancient TD – A Mythological Co-op Tower Defense Experience

Tower Defense Reimagined
Build and upgrade powerful towers inspired by ancient gods and heroes. Each tower has unique abilities to help you face an onslaught of enemies.

4-Player Co-op
Play solo or team up with up to 3 other players. Combine towers, coordinate artifacts, and support each other with unique peasants and builds.

Mythic Setting
Fight in a world rooted in ancient mythology. Face legendary beasts, cursed warriors, and divine challenges as you defend your land.

Unique Peasants
Peasants are unlockable characters that grant powerful passive skills. Choose one at the start of each match to drastically change your strategy and enhance gameplay.

Artifact Challenges
Powerful challenge monsters roam the battlefield. Defeat them to choose from random artifacts that grant game-changing effects for the rest of the match.

Rune Collection System
Collect permanent stat-boosting runes through treasure rewards. Customize your playstyle and grow stronger with every run.

Epic Items and Treasures
Unlock and equip a wide variety of unique items, each with its own stats and effects. Synergize your gear with tower types and peasant skills for maximum power.

Endless Mode – Ultimate Challenge

After defeating all standard waves, enter Endless Mode. Push to Wave 100 to unlock the highest rewards and maximum difficulty scaled to your time spent.
